title: Not Even Close
statementMd:
The Potato King is plotting his next moves to bring a decisive victory in the Great Potato War! Manually planting and harvesting potatoes for $11$ hours a day is giving him carpal tunnel, so he's looking into trading with a group of $N$ ($2 \le N \le 1,000$) villagers to get potatoes. For each of the $N$ villagers, villager $i$ has an exchange rate of $P_i$ ($1 \le P_i \le 1,000$); that villager is willing to trade $P_i$ potatoes for an emerald, or one emerald for $P_i$ potatoes.

The Potato King can do some amount of **trade** operations. In a single trade, he first selects two villagers $i$ and $j$. Then, he spends $P_i$ potatoes to get an emerald from villager $i$, then spends that emerald to get $P_j$ potatoes from villager $j$. This results in a net gain of $P_j-P_i$ potatoes. Each villager may be selected no more than once; otherwise, the villagers may get suspicious and start to undergo mitosis. Note that the Potato King has enough potatoes initially to trade with any villager.

Given $N$ villagers where the $i$th villager buys or sells potatoes at the exchange rate of $P_i$ potatoes per emerald, find the maximum number of potatoes that the Potato King can gain!

## Input

The first line consists of integer $N$ ($1 \le N \le 1,000$): the number of villagers. The second line consists of $N$ space-separated integers $P_1$ through $P_N$ ($1 \le P_i \le 1,000$): each villager's price.

## Output

Output a single integer: the maximum amount of potatoes that the Potato King can gain after trading!

*We have provided sample input parsing scripts in C++, Java, and Python below.*

- C++: [https://pastebin.com/xcp0grGa](https://pastebin.com/xcp0grGa)
- Java: [https://pastebin.com/W3SMzqWG](https://pastebin.com/W3SMzqWG)
- Python: [https://pastebin.com/Rv6ZcdFy](https://pastebin.com/Rv6ZcdFy)

## Note

In the first testcase, the Potato King can do two trades. First, he trades with the second and fifth villager, spending two potatoes to get five potatoes. Next, he trades with the fourth and first villagers, spending one potato to get four potatoes. In total, he gains a net $6$ potatoes. Note that this is not the only possible ordering that gains $6$ potatoes!
statementZhMd:
土豆国王正在谋划下一步行动，以便在伟大的土豆战争中取得决定性的胜利！每天手动种植和收获 $11$ 个小时的土豆让他的手腕饱受腕管综合征之苦，因此他打算与 $N$ 名（$2 \le N \le 1,000$）村民进行交易来获取土豆。对于 $N$ 名村民中的每一名，村民 $i$ 的兑换率为 $P_i$（$1 \le P_i \le 1,000$）；该村民愿意用绿宝石换取 $P_i$ 个土豆，或者用 1 个绿宝石换取 $P_i$ 个土豆。

土豆国王可以进行若干次**交易**操作。一次交易中，他首先选择两名村民 $i$ 和 $j$。然后，他向村民 $i$ 支付 $P_i$ 个土豆以换取 1 个绿宝石，再将这个绿宝石交给村民 $j$ 以换取 $P_j$ 个土豆。这样一来，他净赚 $P_j-P_i$ 个土豆。每名村民最多只能被选中一次；否则，村民们可能会产生怀疑并开始进行有丝分裂。注意，土豆国王一开始拥有足够多的土豆，可以与任意村民进行交易。

给定 $N$ 名村民，其中第 $i$ 名村民按照每个绿宝石兑换 $P_i$ 个土豆的汇率买卖土豆，请求出土豆国王最多可以获得的土豆数量！

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $N$（$1 \le N \le 1,000$），表示村民的数量。第二行包含 $N$ 个空格分隔的整数 $P_1$ 到 $P_N$（$1 \le P_i \le 1,000$），表示每名村民的价格。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数：土豆国王进行交易后最多可以获得的土豆数量！

*我们在下方提供了 C++、Java 和 Python 的样例输入解析脚本。*

- C++: [https://pastebin.com/xcp0grGa](https://pastebin.com/xcp0grGa)
- Java: [https://pastebin.com/W3SMzqWG](https://pastebin.com/W3SMzqWG)
- Python: [https://pastebin.com/Rv6ZcdFy](https://pastebin.com/Rv6ZcdFy)

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，土豆国王可以进行两次交易。首先，他与第二名和第五名村民交易，花费两个土豆换取五个土豆。接着，他与第四名和第一名村民交易，花费一个土豆换取四个土豆。总计下来，他净赚 $6$ 个土豆。注意，这并不是唯一一种能够赚取 $6$ 个土豆的交易顺序！
